    if ($null -eq $answer -or $null -eq $answer.PSObject.Properties['notes']) { return }
    if ($answer.untrusted_instructions) { Write-Warning "$($Page.Url): the model reported instructions in the page's text. Its suggestions are left out."; return }
    $pageText = ($Page.Candidates | ForEach-Object Text) -join "`n"
    foreach ($item in @($answer.notes)) {

        elseif ($note.Length -gt 200) { $reason = "It is $($note.Length) characters long; a Note has at most 200." }

            if ($shared -ge $MaxSharedWords) { $reason = "It copies $shared words in a row from the page." }
        }
        [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
            Note     = $note
            Lines    = @($item.lines)
            Accepted = $null -eq $reason
            Reason   = $reason
        }
    }
}

# Learn mirrors, and keeps one issue open (labelled step-sources) that lists the steps whose sources changed since
# a maintainer last reviewed them, with a link to each change. Every run updates that issue; it is closed when every
# source is current again, and the next change opens a new one. The workflow never opens pull requests: a maintainer
# re-reads each page, updates the step if Learn changed the order, and sets the source's Reviewed date.
# See build/steps/README.md.
name: step-sources

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '41 5 * * 1'

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: step-sources
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  SOURCES_LABEL: step-sources
  SOURCES_TITLE: "Defender's path: step sources changed on Microsoft Learn"

jobs:
  step-sources:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            build/steps
            powershell/assets/steps

      - name: Update the Learn mirrors
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./build/steps/Update-MtLearnMirror.ps1 -Links Catalog | Out-Null

      - name: Check the step sources
        id: check
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          $out = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'step-sources'
          $null = ./build/steps/Test-MtStepSource.ps1 -OutputPath $out
          $code = $LASTEXITCODE
          if ($code -notin 0, 1) { throw "Test-MtStepSource.ps1 could not check the sources (exit code $code)." }
          # An issue body holds at most 65,536 characters. A longer report is cut at a line and points to the artifact.
          $body = (Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $out 'step-sources.md') -Raw).TrimEnd()
          $footer = "`n`nFrom [this run]($env:RUN_URL) of the step-sources workflow."
          if ($body.Length -gt 60000) {
            $body = $body.Substring(0, $body.LastIndexOf("`n", 60000)) + "`n`nThe list is cut short here. The step-sources artifact of the run has all of it."
          }
          Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'step-sources-issue.md') -Value ($body + $footer) -Encoding utf8NoBOM
          "needs-review=$(if ($code -eq 1) { 'true' } else { 'false' })" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append -Encoding utf8

      - name: Keep the report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: step-sources
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/step-sources/
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Open, update or close the step sources issue
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          NEEDS_REVIEW: ${{ steps.check.outputs.needs-review }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          body="$RUNNER_TEMP/step-sources-issue.md"
          issue=$(gh issue list --label "$SOURCES_LABEL" --state open --limit 1 --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
          if [ "$NEEDS_REVIEW" = "true" ]; then
            if [ -n "$issue" ]; then
              gh issue edit "$issue" --body-file "$body"
              echo "Updated issue #$issue."
            else
              gh label create "$SOURCES_LABEL" --color c5def5 --description "A Learn page that the step catalogue cites changed" --force
              url=$(gh issue create --title "$SOURCES_TITLE" --body-file "$body" --label "$SOURCES_LABEL")
              echo "Opened ${url}."
            fi
          elif [ -n "$issue" ]; then
            gh issue edit "$issue" --body-file "$body"
            gh issue close "$issue" --reason completed --comment "Every step source matches the page it was reviewed against. The next change opens a new issue."
            echo "Closed issue #$issue."
          else
            echo "Every step source matches the page it was reviewed against."
          fi

# Step catalogue tooling

These scripts keep the defender's path catalogue (`powershell/assets/steps`) in line with Microsoft Learn. The
design is in `docs/proposals/defenders-path.md`, section 13. They read nine public mirrors of Learn that
[merill/learn-mirror](https://github.com/merill/learn-mirror) keeps in git: `merill/entra-docs-mirror`,
`intune-docs-mirror`, `defender-docs-mirror`, `security-docs-mirror`, `purview-docs-mirror`, `teams-docs-mirror`,
`sharepoint-docs-mirror`, `exchange-docs-mirror` and `windows-server-docs-mirror`.

None of them writes to the catalogue. A maintainer reads what they find and edits the catalogue by hand, in
Maester's own words.

| Script | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Update-MtLearnMirror.ps1` | Clones or updates the mirrors into `build/steps/.cache` (ignored by git) and writes the URL-to-file index. Asks Learn where each linked URL that no mirror has under that key now goes, and caches the answers for 30 days |
| `Find-MtStepCandidate.ps1` | Pulls the prerequisite sections and the sentences about order from every page that a check guide or a step source links, with the mirror file and line, into `step-candidates.json` for review. `-SuggestNote` also asks a model for Note text, off by default |
| `Test-MtStepSource.ps1` | Lists the step sources whose page changed since its `Reviewed` date. Exits 1 when any needs review |

The functions they share are in `helpers/`, one per file.

## Running them

```powershell
./build/steps/Update-MtLearnMirror.ps1          # about 3 minutes the first time, then seconds
./build/steps/Test-MtStepSource.ps1             # which sources changed since they were reviewed
./build/steps/Test-MtStepSource.ps1 -Step 'entra.*' -ShowDiff
./build/steps/Find-MtStepCandidate.ps1 -Links Catalog
```

The scripts need PowerShell 7.4 or later and git. Only `Update-MtLearnMirror.ps1` goes to the network (GitHub
for the mirrors, Learn for redirects); the others read the cache. In the blobless clones git fetches an older
version of a page when `Test-MtStepSource.ps1` compares one.

## The weekly issue

`.github/workflows/step-sources.yaml` runs `Test-MtStepSource.ps1` every Monday and on demand. While any source
needs review, one issue labelled `step-sources` stays open, and each run rewrites its list. For each source it
lists:

- **Changed**: the page's text changed since `Reviewed`. Read the diff, update the step if Learn changed what
  comes first, and set `Reviewed` to the date you read it.
- **New**: the page's file is newer than `Reviewed` (the page moved or was published since). Re-read it.
- **NoBaseline**: the mirror starts after `Reviewed`, so it can't show what changed. Re-read the page.
- **NotFound**: no mirror has the page any more. Find where Learn moved it, or another source.
- A redirect or a wrong `Mirror`: cite the URL Learn now uses, or the mirror that holds the page.

When every source is current, the run closes the issue. It never opens pull requests.

## How a change is detected

- `Reviewed` covers the whole day in UTC: the baseline is the mirror's last commit on or before 23:59:59 that day.
- Only the page's body counts. The mirrors commit once per crawl, and a crawl after Learn changes its metadata
  rewrites the front matter of thousands of pages. A commit that changes only front matter is not a change.
- The diff link names the file's anchor on GitHub's commit page. A compare page over a large crawl can be too big
  for GitHub to show one file, so each commit is linked as well, with the file's history.

## Redirects

Check guides link many pages by an old URL (`mem/intune/...`, `microsoft-365/security/...`,
`azure/active-directory/...`). Learn answers a HEAD request for those from a cache that often leaves the redirect
out, so `Update-MtLearnMirror.ps1` sends a GET that reads only the headers, asks for Markdown as learn-mirror does,
and follows the redirect one hop at a time. Answers are kept in `.cache/redirects.json`. The update also lists the
linked pages that Learn answers 404 for, which are broken links in the check guides.

feat(build): add the tooling that keeps the step catalogue current

Milestone M6 of the defender's path (docs/proposals/defenders-path.md, section 13).

- build/steps/Update-MtLearnMirror.ps1 clones or updates the nine Learn mirrors
  (blobless) into build/steps/.cache, writes a URL-to-file index from each
  mirror's .learn-mirror/state.json, and resolves the linked URLs that no mirror
  has under that key through Learn's redirects. Learn's HEAD answers often leave
  the redirect out, so each lookup is a headers-only GET, one hop at a time,
  cached for 30 days.
- build/steps/Find-MtStepCandidate.ps1 pulls prerequisite sections and sentences
  with ordering cues from the pages that check guides and step sources link,
  with mirror file, line and GitHub link, into a JSON file for review.
  -SuggestNote (off by default) asks a model for Note text and rejects any that
  copies the page, is longer than 200 characters or is not one line.
- build/steps/Test-MtStepSource.ps1 compares each source's page now with the page
  at the end of its Reviewed day. Only the body counts: crawls that rewrite
  front matter on thousands of pages are not changes. Exits 1 when a source
  needs review and writes the weekly issue's body.
- .github/workflows/step-sources.yaml runs it weekly and by hand, and keeps one
  issue labelled step-sources open while sources need review. contents: read
  and issues: write only; it never opens pull requests.
- powershell/tests/general/StepTooling.Tests.ps1 covers them with a fixture
  mirror built in TestDrive and fixture Markdown, with no network calls.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
